analysis:
Examined CHANGELOG.md head lines 1-376. The only changed range is head 11-39, which adds the v0.10.10 candidate section. That section documents a new `darkbloom waitlist` CLI and an account-approval gate for new sandbox setup and new cluster pairs. The patch also relabels the v0.10.9 section heading as published. This is documentation only; no source is in this batch.

Security-relevant claims for integration to verify against source:
(1) Lines 19 and 33: new sandbox and cluster setups fail closed (exit 1) when the user is not logged in, is refused, or the coordinator is unreachable.
(2) Line 22 and line 33's last sentence: a coordinator without waitlists lets setup proceed. This is a fail-open compatibility path. The waitlist is a coordinator-side product gate, not a security control. The provider client cannot be trusted to enforce it against ADV-001, since an operator controls the binary (TB-003). Real enforcement must stay in coordinator registration and pair approval (TB-011, T-052). Integration should confirm source does not treat a client-side approval check as authorization.
(3) Line 32: joining a waitlist sends nothing about the Mac. Verify the request carries no machine identifiers (T-058 linkage).
(4) Line 18: `--yes` auto-joins the sandbox waitlist. This is a consent nuance only.
(5) The sandbox installer path (TB-013, T-061) is unchanged per the notes; the gate runs before the download.
(6) Line 20: `darkbloom cluster local` needs no approval and works offline.

No regression is evidenced in changelog text alone. The threat model may need a note that the waitlist gate is advisory client UX, not authorization.
